description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube - Player buttons
- **Video title no longer runs under the overlay buttons:** with Save to watch later, Reload video, Picture-in-picture or the SponsorBlock buttons on, a long title in fullscreen is now cut off before the left-most button instead of running underneath it. YouTube rewrote the title's end constraint after the overlay was inflated, which dropped the added buttons from it.

## Notes
- The YouTube Music deep-link button, which only shows for some accounts, now sits to the left of the added overlay buttons.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2)
